Disney's capital expenditures (investments in parks, resorts and other property) in fiscal Q4 2025, the quarter ended September 27, 2025, were roughly $2.4 billion. This is my best estimate. Disney does not report Q4 separately in its 10-K, so I derived it from memory of the filings rather than from a reported figure.

- Full-year fiscal 2025 capex was about $8.0 billion.
- Capex for the first nine months was about $5.6 billion, which I recalled only approximately.
- Subtracting the nine-month figure from the full year gives about $2.4 billion for Q4.
